I'm really concerned that you're hitting yourself, and I want you to know that you don't deserve to be hurt by anyone, including yourself. The length of a relationship doesn't measure your worth or whether you were "good enough"—sometimes things just don't work out, and that's not a reflection of you being broken or bad. Please reach out to someone right now, like the Crisis Text Line (text HOME to 741741) or the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, so you can talk through what you're feeling with someone who can support you.

Your feelings of sadness and frustration make sense, but punishing yourself isn't the answer. You deserve care and compassion, especially from yourself. Please consider reaching out to a trusted friend, family member, or counselor who can be with you right now. You matter, and this painful moment doesn't define you.
